title: Fuchsfelge - Verwendungsbereich / Application area Porsche 993 (July 2020 leaflet)
notes: Two-page bilingual leaflet dated July 2020 in its margin (PDF created 2020-07-15), downloaded and read on 2026-10-15; no copy is kept in the repository. For the Porsche 993 it lists front 7J x 17 ET55 at 7.50 kg and rear 9J x 17 ET55 at 7.95 kg, front 8J x 18 ET52 at 8.20 kg and rear 10J x 18 ET65 at 8.80 kg, each with tyre sizes; for 993 Turbo/Turbo Look the 17-inch rear notes an optional 32 mm spacer for appearance (individual approval then required) and the 18-inch rear is listed only with a 25 mm spacer. Prices per wheel are shown with 16 % VAT, so they are 2020 list prices, not current availability. Inline component citations: FUCHS-993-PDF in COMP-FUCHS-37024.013, -37026.013, -37027.011 and -37028.011, and FUCHS-993-APPLICATION in ASM-993-FUCHS-17-WHEEL-SET. Masses are manufacturer declarations without tolerance.
